description: This script processes markdown files within a directory structure related to educational roadmaps. It reads directories, identifies markdown files, and prepends link types (e.g., @article@, @video@) to markdown links based on hostname analysis, classifying links into categories like official, article, course, etc.

methods.name: getHostNameWithoutTld
methods.description: Extracts the hostname without the top-level domain from a given hostname.

methods.name: isOfficialWebsite
methods.description: Determines if a given hostname and filename correspond to an official website within the roadmap context.

methods.name: getTypeFromHostname
methods.description: Classifies a hostname into categories like article, video, course, etc., based on predefined hostname lists.

methods.name: readNestedMarkdownFiles
methods.description: Recursively reads directories to find all markdown (.md) files.
